root_cause: Postrelease terminal closure #39840439339 treated SQL path in closed/unmerged #4686 as unshipped even though protected-merged #4697 delivered exactly that path; unconditional fail prevented otherwise completed migration provider check.
fix: Permit a closed unmerged ancestor SQL path only when the already-seen merged same-obligation successor delivered the exact identical path; reject any unique or renamed SQL.
prevention_rule: Terminalizer must preserve supersession migrations on exact merged evidence; never infer release from an unmerged PR or bypass protected migration/ACL/provider gates.
